thread:
maya: Heads-up: created a slimline reference-arch package for the new cloud marketplace partners. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-refarchs (path: /cloud-enablement/marketplace-package). Need quick tech review and a checklist for marketplace certs.
tomas: Nice. Which artifacts are included? templates, terraform modules, samples?
maya: Included: Terraform modules (network, compute, k8s-operator), a small Helm chart for the inference service, ARM/Bicep for Azure listing, and a packaging script for each marketplace. Also a minimal example app that hits the Redwood hosted API to demonstrate integration.
alisa: Do we have SI integration notes? e.g., how a systems integrator should wire this into customer VPCs and partner-managed IDPs?
maya: There's a /docs/si-integration.md with guidance on VPC peering, private endpoints, and SAML vs OIDC patterns. It's intentionally high-level for SIs; we'll add a partner-specific runbook later.
partner-pm: Marketplace compliance question: for AWS and Azure we need specific ARM/Bicep/CloudFormation outputs for packaging. Are we generating those automatically?
maya: We added CloudFormation templates in /examples/aws/cloudformation and ARM/Bicep in /examples/azure. The publish script can generate the marketplace manifests; see scripts/publish_marketplace.sh. It requires credentials and will create a packaged artifact under /dist.
tomas: Can we decouple the modules so partners can swap out the operator chart? e.g., allow `chart_source` var to point to registry or local path.
alisa: Also add a quick example to show using an existing partner operator instead of ours. Some partners will want their own managed K8s agent.
maya: Good call. I added `use_external_chart` bool + `chart_registry_url` var. Examples updated for each cloud.
infra-bot: CI `marketplace-refarchs/main` started for PR #47 (workflow: marketplace-publish-checks).
partner-pm: For certification we need a diagram and a short performance note (expected token throughput for a 4x A100 node pool). Can engineering drop a short TXN/per-second estimate?
tomas: I can add a baseline: with our standard refarch (4x A100, g4dn equiv), expect ~1200-1600 tokens/sec for batched gen workload at batch_size 8. I'll add a short note and a script to reproduce the microbench.
alisa: Please add the security checklist items: KMS integration, K8s PSP/PodSecurity, network ACLs, and logging/retention settings that marketplaces require.
maya: Added SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md and updated marketplace manifest to flag required controls. Also added a short compliance note about not logging raw prompts by default.
partner-pm: Great. Who owns the Terraform registry publishing? We need module namespace for partners to consume.
maya: Ownership: tomas will publish the first set to the Terraform registry (namespace: redwood-inference/marketplace). Versioning strategy: `v0.1.0-marketplace` then semver.
tomas: will do. I'll also add a simple `publish.sh` that tags and pushes a release and triggers the release pipeline.
infra-bot: Workflow `marketplace-publish-checks` passed for PR #47 :white_check_mark:.
alisa: Minor: example variable names used `env` in some examples and `deployment_env` in others. Please normalize to `deployment_env`.
maya: Normalized across all examples and added example.tfvars for aws/azure/gcp in /examples/common.
partner-pm: Timeline: partner visible package by 2026-04-12, marketplace certification by 2026-04-26. Can we hit that?
tomas: On track if we finish the registry publish and the marketplace packaging scripts by next week.
alisa: I'll review SI notes and add a one-page runbook for integrators.
maya: Thanks all. Action items: tomas = publish modules + tag, alisa = SI runbook + security checklist review, maya = finalize packaging script and add diagram. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
tomas: :white_check_mark:
alisa: :white_check_mark:
partner-pm: Thanks everyone, leaving notes for partner ops to start certification intake.
